description: labels_unicode (café ✅ 日本語) ~0.82. Two coupled issues: (1) TrebuchetSizeEstimator mis-measures CJK ideographs (should be ~1.0em full-width) — a fix resolved the dimension warning but net eval was flat (reverted as it didn't improve SSIM); (2) the eval rasterizer renders emoji as tofu without a color/CJK font fallback — a fallback made emoji render correctly but pointwise-misaligned and net -0.2pp (reverted). Needs the measurement + eval-font fixes landed together, or same-engine rasterization. Deferred.
title: flowchart: CJK/emoji label width measurement + resvg glyph fallback
